description.value: A large adult-oriented RV park just off the Trans-Canada Highway at Hope, offering full-hookup sites with showers, cable TV, and wi-fi included; no tent rate is listed and the park caters primarily to RV travellers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact tags exactly (address, phone, email). The about page confirms 17 acres, 150 full-service RV sites, and 40+ years of operation; the sites-and-rates page explicitly lists hot showers, Wi-Fi, and basic cable as included, and confirms cabin availability; the reservation page confirms bookings are accepted by phone or email. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, tools, or cyclist discounts anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name ('Hope Valley RV & Campground') differs slightly from website branding, which alternates between 'Hope Valley Campground and RV Park' and 'Hope Valley RV Park'.
About page describes the park as 'Adult oriented,' which may affect family cyclists; the rate sheet does include children under 16, so the policy is ambiguous.
Wi-Fi does not cover the entire campground per the sites-and-rates page footnote.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established campground with showers, cabins, and full hookups on a major Trans-Canada cycling corridor near Hope, BC; a practical and well-documented overnight option for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: hot showers, Wi-Fi, and basic cable as included... 17 acres, 150 full-service RV sites, and 40+ years of operation
